shots.src: IRAQ · 2016 · TRANSPORT MINISTER, PRESS CONFERENCE

lines.text: In twenty sixteen, at a press conference in Iraq, the country's transport minister made an astonishing claim. Five thousand years ago, he said, the Sumerians built an airport in the south of his country, and launched spaceships from it.
His source was not an excavation. It was a book from nineteen seventy-six, which says that beings called the Anunnaki came down from a hidden planet, mined gold on Earth, and created us.
The name Anunnaki is real. It appears on clay again and again, across two thousand years of Mesopotamian texts. The question is what the people who wrote it actually meant.

So tonight we read that one word three ways. Reading one: they were gods. Reading two: they were kings, remembered as gods. Reading three: they were visitors from space. Each reading gets tested against the tablets. Then a scorecard, and a verdict.
First, how do we know anything at all? Writing began here, in southern Iraq, more than five thousand years ago. Early cities like Uruk kept their accounts by pressing marks into wet clay.

shots.src: EST. 500,000–2,000,000 TABLETS EXCAVATED · ~30,000–100,000 PUBLISHED

lines.text: Clay survives. Between half a million and two million cuneiform tablets have been dug up in modern times. Only a fraction, perhaps thirty to a hundred thousand, have been read and published.
For two thousand years nobody could read them. Scholars rebuilt the script in the nineteenth century, and today a myth can be checked line by line.

shots.src: SIGN: DINGIR · 'SKY' / 'GOD' · SILENT MARK OF A DIVINE NAME

lines.text: One sign matters for our case. It looks like a star. On its own it means sky, or heaven. Written before a name, it is silent, and simply marks that name as divine. Scholars call it dingir.
Remember that star. It returns in all three readings, because the argument turns on who is allowed to wear it.

shots.src: A-NUN-NA · 'PRINCELY OFFSPRING' · CHILDREN OF AN & KI

lines.text: Reading one is the plainest. In Sumerian the name is written a-nun-na, probably meaning princely offspring. The Anunna were the children of An, the sky, and Ki, the earth.

shots.src: EARLIEST USE · GUDEA OF LAGASH c. 2144–2124 BC · UR III

lines.text: The earliest known uses of the word come from inscriptions of Gudea, ruler of Lagash, around twenty one hundred BC, and from the Third Dynasty of Ur.

shots.src: 'THE SEVEN GODS WHO DECREE'

lines.text: In the oldest texts they are the great gods themselves, probably the seven who decree: An, Enlil, Enki, Ninhursag, Nanna, Utu and Inanna. Their job, the poems say, was to decree the fates of mankind.

shots.src: ERIDU: 50 · INANNA'S DESCENT: 7 · ENŪMA ELIŠ: 300 + 600

lines.text: But the tablets never agree on how many there were. One text links fifty Anunnaki to the city of Eridu. In Inanna's Descent there are just seven, sitting as judges in the underworld. A late Babylonian epic counts three hundred in heaven and six hundred below.
No complete list of their names has ever been found, and no temple or picture of them as a group. As a team, they live almost only in literature.
Mesopotamians pictured a god as a giant in human form, wrapped in a terrifying radiance, living in its temple, inside its statue. Priests dressed that statue, and set meals before it.
The gods even had vehicles: barges and chariots. They carried the statues to festivals, and sometimes to a battlefield, so the god could watch.

shots.src: ATRAHASIS · OLD BABYLONIAN COPY c. 1650 BC

lines.text: Now the most important tablet of all, because the visitor theory is built on it. The Babylonian epic of Atrahasis opens: when the gods, like men, did the work. Junior gods, the Igigi, dig the rivers and canals while the senior gods rule.
The workers revolt. At night they surround the house of Enlil, chief of the gods. To end the strike, the gods decide to make a substitute: a creature that will carry the load instead.

shots.src: ATRAHASIS I · CLAY + THE BLOOD OF A SLAIN GOD

lines.text: Enki and the mother goddess Mami take clay, mix it with the blood of a slain god, and shape the first humans. Mami hands them a carrying basket. Humanity is born as labor.
Then humans multiply, and their noise keeps the gods awake. Plague, drought, and finally a flood. Enki warns one wise man, Atrahasis, who builds a boat and survives.

shots.src: ATRAHASIS III · 'THE ANUNNAKI WERE SITTING IN THIRST AND HUNGER'

lines.text: And here is the detail that matters most. During the flood, with no humans left to feed them, the gods go hungry and thirsty. When Atrahasis makes his offering, they gather around it like flies.
Over time the word even drifts. Later, Anunnaki usually means the gods of the underworld, and Igigi the gods of heaven.
Finding for reading one. In the tablets, the Anunnaki are gods: immortal, quarrelsome, fed by sacrifice. That is not our interpretation. It is how the scribes wrote them.
Reading two is older than it sounds. Around three hundred BC the Greek writer Euhemerus argued that gods were simply famous rulers, remembered and exaggerated. Maybe the Anunnaki were real kings.

shots.src: SUMERIAN KING LIST · WELD-BLUNDELL PRISM · ISIN DYNASTY

lines.text: The star witness for this reading is the Sumerian King List. Its best-known copy, the Weld-Blundell prism, dates to the reign of King Sin-magir of Isin.

shots.src: 'AFTER THE KINGSHIP DESCENDED FROM HEAVEN…'

lines.text: It opens: after the kingship descended from heaven, the kingship was in Eridu. Kingship literally comes down from the sky.

shots.src: 8 KINGS BEFORE THE FLOOD · 241,200 YEARS · ALULIM: 28,800

lines.text: Then come eight kings before the flood. The first, Alulim, rules twenty-eight thousand eight hundred years. Together they reign two hundred forty-one thousand two hundred years. One of them, Dumuzid, is a well-known god.
After the flood, kingship descends again, to Kish, and the reigns start to shrink, from centuries to decades. Legend fading into history.

shots.src: ETANA · 'WHO ASCENDED TO HEAVEN'

lines.text: Alien fans love one entry: Etana, the king who ascended to heaven. In his own myth he flies there on the back of an eagle, a story, not a flight report.

shots.src: GILGAMESH OF URUK · 126 YEARS (KING LIST)

lines.text: And then a name everyone knows: Gilgamesh of Uruk, given one hundred twenty-six years, and a father described as a phantom. Most historians think a real Gilgamesh ruled Uruk early in the third millennium BC, and was later worshipped as a god.
But historians read the King List as politics. Each dynasty edited it to show that kingship had always passed to one city at a time, and now belonged to them.

shots.src: VICTORY STELE OF NARAM-SIN · LOUVRE (AI RECONSTRUCTION)

lines.text: Then the evidence turns. Around twenty two hundred fifty BC, Naram-Sin of Akkad became the first Mesopotamian king known to claim divinity. On his victory stele he climbs a mountain wearing a horned helmet, the headgear of a god.

shots.src: BASSETKI STATUE · FOUND 1974 · 'THE GOD OF THEIR CITY'

lines.text: A statue base found in nineteen seventy-four, at Bassetki, says why. After he crushed a great revolt, the citizens asked the great gods that Naram-Sin be made the god of their city, and they built him a temple.
From then on his name is written with the star of divinity in front of it. Later, Shulgi of Ur did the same, and the kings of Ur called Gilgamesh their divine brother.
Finding for reading two. Some kings really did become gods. But they climbed into a divine category that already existed. The great gods are never presented as retired kings.

shots.src: Z. SITCHIN · THE 12TH PLANET · 1976

lines.text: Reading three is the one most people have heard. In nineteen seventy-six, Zecharia Sitchin published The Twelfth Planet. His books have sold millions of copies, in more than twenty-five languages.
Sitchin, born in Baku, was a journalist and then a shipping executive in New York, who taught himself to read cuneiform.
He built on Erich von Däniken's Chariots of the Gods, from nineteen sixty-eight, which read Sumerian texts as alien contact, and turned it into a full history.
His claim: beyond Neptune hides a planet called Nibiru, on a long elliptical orbit that brings it into the inner solar system every three thousand six hundred years.
Its people, the Anunnaki, landed on Earth about four hundred fifty thousand years ago looking for gold, and mined it in Africa.
When the miners rebelled against the work, Enki proposed a worker made by crossing their genes with those of Homo erectus. Humanity, says Sitchin, was a slave species built for the mines.

Notice what he did. That is the Atrahasis story from reading one. Sitchin kept the plot, and swapped clay and blood for genetic engineering. It is his strongest card, because the myth really does say humans were made as labor.
He went further. The evil wind in the Lament for Ur, he wrote, was fallout from nuclear weapons, used in a war between alien factions, in the year twenty twenty-four BC.

shots.src: NIBIRU DOOMSDAY DATES · 2003 · 2012 · 2017

lines.text: Nibiru then escaped the books. Doomsday websites predicted its arrival in two thousand three, then twenty twelve, then twenty seventeen. NASA's answer never changed: Nibiru does not exist.

shots.src: NIMRUD · NORTHWEST PALACE · c. 883–859 BC (AI RECONSTRUCTION)

lines.text: Ancient astronaut fans add pictures. Assyrian palace reliefs show winged figures carrying what looks like a handbag, and wearing what looks like a wristwatch.

shots.src: SEAL VA 243 · VORDERASIATISCHES MUSEUM, BERLIN (AI RECONSTRUCTION)

lines.text: And a cylinder seal in Berlin, catalogue number VA two forty-three, which Sitchin read as the Sun circled by eleven planets. Twelve bodies in all: the twelfth planet.
Now the test. We check Sitchin the way any translation is checked: against dictionaries, other copies, and specialists. Five claims.

shots.src: NĒBERU = 'CROSSING' · ENŪMA ELIŠ V: MARDUK'S STAR · JUPITER

lines.text: Claim one: Nibiru. In Akkadian, nibiru means crossing, a ford or a ferry. In the creation epic, Nibiru is Marduk's star, which he made visible in heaven to mark the turning point of the stars. Babylonian astronomy ties it to Jupiter.
The orbit also fails on physics. A planet on that path would not keep the same period for even two passes. And a body that big would be easy to see.

shots.src: CUNEIFORM ASTRONOMY · 5 NAKED-EYE PLANETS

lines.text: Claim two: twelve planets. The catalogued cuneiform astronomy texts, from the MUL-APIN compendium on, know five planets, the ones visible to the naked eye. Not one tablet counts more.

shots.src: VA 243 INSCRIPTION · 'DUBSIGA, ILI-ILLAT, YOUR SERVANT' (MOORTGAT 1940)

lines.text: Claim three: the seal. Its lines of writing, which Sitchin did not discuss, read: Dubsiga, Ili-illat, your servant. A name, an owner, a dedication. Nothing about planets.

shots.src: SUN = DISK WITH WAVY RAYS · STAR = MARK OF A GOD

lines.text: And the central symbol is not the Sun. The Sun god's disk has wavy rays inside a circle. This is a star, the usual marker of a god, and dots are how artists drew stars.

shots.src: FRITZE, INVENTED KNOWLEDGE (2009)

lines.text: Claim four: the words. Sitchin said the sign dingir meant pure ones of the blazing rockets. The sign is a star, meaning sky or god. Historians who checked his references found quotations cut short and taken out of context.

shots.src: THE MET · NIMRUD RELIEF 31.72.3 · BUCKET + 'PURIFIER'

lines.text: Claim five: the handbag. The museums that hold these reliefs explain it. The bucket held holy water, and the cone, called in Akkadian a purifier, sprinkled it. The wristwatch is a bracelet with a rosette, a symbol of divinity.

One last check. In Atrahasis, people are made of clay and divine blood, not genes, and their makers nearly starve without our offerings. Starfaring engineers who need us to feed them? The tablet describes gods.
Case closed. Here is the scorecard.
The Anunnaki appear in real texts: evidence. In those texts they are gods: evidence. Some kings became gods: evidence, from Naram-Sin on. The great gods were once kings: no evidence.
Nibiru is a hidden planet: debunked, it is Marduk's star. Seal VA two forty-three shows the solar system: debunked. The Anunnaki were visitors from space: no evidence.
The verdict. Reading one wins. The Anunnaki were gods: the princely children of the sky, who decreed fates, judged the dead, and needed to be fed.
Reading two survives as a footnote. Kings like Naram-Sin and Shulgi reached up for the star of divinity. But the gods were there first.
Reading three is a modern story written over an ancient one. It took a real myth about labor and rebellion, and replaced clay with DNA, a star with a planet, and a servant's seal with a map of space.
The real tablets are stranger, and better: gods on strike, kings who became gods, and the first humans, handed a basket. Anyone can read them now, line by line.
That is the case. Gods, kings, or visitors: which reading convinced you? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for the next ancient mystery on trial.
